title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth continues her vigil at Netherfield, facing the barely concealed disdain of the Bingley sisters. A spirited debate on the nature of 'accomplished women' reveals the deep intellectual and moral divide between Elizabeth, the Bingleys, and Mr. Darcy. She demonstrates her independence and character in front of everyone.
